country.name: Ethiopia
country.officialLocalName: Federal Democratic Republic of Ethiopia / የኢትዮጵያ ፌዴራላዊ ዴሞክራሲያዊ ሪፐብሊክ
country.jurisdictionNotice: Education is decentralized. The federal Ministry, regional and city-administration education bureaus, the Education and Training Authority, assessment bodies and TVET authorities have distinct mandates. A federal source never silently replaces the competent regional record.
country.languagePolicy: Amharic is the federal working language, while regions use Oromo, Somali, Tigrinya, Afar, Sidama, Wolaytta and many other languages in education. Preserve exact language, script, region, grade, approving authority and effective version; translation is not localization.

review.policy: No category becomes verified without a named qualified Ethiopian reviewer and current evidence from the competent federal, regional or city-administration authority.

governanceModel.summary: The federal Ministry sets national policy and standards; regional and city-administration bureaus implement and administer general education within their mandates; ETA regulates quality across general, TVET and higher education; assessment and TVET functions remain separately governed.
governanceModel.schoolRule: Preserve official institution name and identifier, region or city administration, woreda, locality, stage, ownership, curriculum, language, licence, current operation and census year. Census presence, examination participation and a federal listing are not current regional authorization.
governanceModel.higherEducationRule: Institution licence, institutional accreditation, exact program accreditation, campus, delivery mode, award authority, provisional or full status and validity are separate claims.

authorities.name: Federal Ministry of Education
authorities.role: national education policy, standards, curriculum framework, EMIS and federal-sector leadership

authorities.name: Regional and city-administration education bureaus
authorities.role: territorial administration, school licensing, implementation, inspection and current institution records within mandate

authorities.name: Education and Training Authority
authorities.role: licensing, accreditation and quality assurance across general education, TVET and higher education within its legal mandate

authorities.name: ETA Accreditation Data Management System
authorities.role: public higher-education institutional and program accreditation decisions

authorities.name: Education Management Information System
authorities.role: dated general-education census and annual statistics

authorities.name: Competent federal and regional TVET authorities
authorities.role: occupational standards, provider oversight, assessment and certification within distinct mandates

authorities.name: Competent national assessment and examinations authority
authorities.role: national assessment, examination and credential functions within current mandate

authorities.name: Federal and regional women and social affairs authorities
authorities.role: child protection, referral and social services within jurisdiction

curriculum.authority: Federal Ministry of Education and competent regional education bureau
curriculum.title: Curriculum Framework for Ethiopian Education (KG–Grade 12) and exact regional curriculum instruments
curriculum.implementationRule: The national framework, regional curriculum, grade-and-subject syllabus, textbook, teacher guide, assessment specification and external resource are not interchangeable. Verify region, stage, grade, subject, language, script, approving authority, instrument, version and effective year.
curriculum.supplementPolicy: National standards may be supplemented by regionally approved curricula and language materials, but neither layer silently replaces the other.

schoolDirectory.authority: Competent regional or city-administration education bureau with federal standards and ETA oversight where applicable
schoolDirectory.scopeNotice: The 2022/23 Education Statistics Annual Abstract supports dated discovery and planning, not current school authorization. Verify each institution through the responsible regional or city-administration record and preserve licence and operating status.
requiredRecordFields: region or city administration, woreda, locality and address
stage, ownership, curriculum and instructional languages
census year, source and review date

educationStatistics.authority: Federal Ministry of Education EMIS with reporting regional bureaus
educationStatistics.scopeNotice: The 2022/23 annual abstract reports dated general-education statistics. Preserve academic year, Ethiopian and Gregorian date mapping, region, stage, ownership, reporting coverage, definition and denominator. Statistics are not a live authorization directory.

vocationalQualifications.authority: Competent federal and regional TVET authorities and ETA within exact mandates
vocationalQualifications.authorityNotice: Provider licence, program approval, occupational standard, assessment-centre authorization, assessment result and qualification certificate are separate claims. Verify authority, region, provider, site, occupation, level, standard version, assessment body, award and validity.

higherEducation.authorityNotice: A provider licence does not prove institutional accreditation; institutional accreditation does not authorize every campus or program; program accreditation must be verified for the exact campus, delivery mode, award, level, status, issue date and validity. Provisional and full accreditation are distinct.

privacyAndSafeguarding.dataProtectionLaw: Personal Data Protection Proclamation No. 1321/2024, in force
privacyAndSafeguarding.dataProtectionAuthority: Personal Data Protection Commission established by Proclamation No. 1321/2024
privacyAndSafeguarding.childrenFramework: Constitutional protections, Revised Family Code as amended, African Charter on the Rights and Welfare of the Child Ratification Proclamation No. 283/2001, General Education Proclamation No. 1368/2025 and applicable federal and regional procedures
privacyAndSafeguarding.scopeNotice: Before a real learner pilot, verify lawful basis, child and sensitive data, biometric use, controller and processor duties, transfers, retention, security, breach handling and learner rights under the 2024 law. Obtain the current school safeguarding, mandatory reporting, referral, consent, inclusion and emergency procedure for the exact region.

culturalAndLanguageRequirements.rule: Amharic, Oromo, Somali, Tigrinya, Afar, Sidama, Wolaytta and other instructional languages are distinct. Preserve region, community, stage, medium of instruction, orthography, terminology, script, accessibility and community review; automatic translation is not localization.

completionCriteria: A qualified Ethiopian education reviewer is named.
Federal, regional and city-administration responsibilities are verified for each claim.
A current public school authorization directory is documented per jurisdiction or the gap remains visible.
Every statistic preserves academic year, date system, region, stage, ownership, reporting coverage, definition and denominator.
Every curriculum record preserves region, grade, subject, language, script, instrument, version and effective year.
Every TVET claim separates provider, program, occupational standard, assessment and award.
Every higher-education claim separately verifies licence, institution, campus, exact program, delivery mode, award, status and validity.
The 2024 data law and current regional school safeguarding procedure are approved before a real learner pilot.
Instructional languages and community contexts remain distinct.
